title: Open Plugin Log
summary: Opens the drag-lint plugin's own log file
intro: Read this when you are diagnosing the drag-lint plugin itself: the About window button opens the plugin's own log file, which shows what it did, what it ran and any errors it hit.

surfaces.caption: Open Plugin Log
steps: Open the About and Status window (drag-lint > About)

questions.ask: What did the drag-lint plugin run, and what errors did it hit?
